senses.en: a child who stays away from school without permission

example.en: The teacher caught two truants behind the shops.
example.zh: 老师在商店后面逮到了两名逃学的学生。

senses.en: absent without permission

example.en: He was truant from school for a week.
example.zh: 他逃学了一个星期。

senses.en: a musician who plays along with a singer or soloist

example.en: The pianist works as an accompanist for the school choir.
example.zh: 这位钢琴家为学校合唱团担任伴奏。

senses.en: added as an explanation or remark inside parentheses or dashes
senses.zh: 插入的；附带的；放在括号里的

example.en: She added a parenthetical note to clarify the date.
example.zh: 她加了一条括注来说明日期。

senses.en: a word or phrase inserted as a side remark, often in parentheses

example.en: Read the parenthetical after the main sentence.
example.zh: 先读主句，再看插入语。

senses.en: a small stand or shop where books are sold

example.en: I bought a second-hand novel from a bookstall at the market.
example.zh: 我在市场的书摊上买了一本二手小说。

senses.en: a self-service laundry with coin-operated washing machines

example.en: I washed my clothes at the launderette down the street.
example.zh: 我在街那头的自助洗衣店洗了衣服。

senses.en: tasks given to someone, especially schoolwork

example.en: The teacher collects assignments every Friday.
example.zh: 老师每周五收作业。

senses.en: jobs or duties given to a person at work

example.en: His overseas assignments lasted three years.
example.zh: 他的海外任职为期三年。

senses.en: to move down quickly through the air, often to attack or catch something

example.en: The eagle swooped down and caught the rabbit.
example.zh: 老鹰俯冲下来抓住了兔子。

senses.en: a fast, sweeping downward movement, often by police or attackers

example.en: Police carried out a swoop on the warehouse early in the morning.
example.zh: 警方清晨对仓库进行了突袭。

senses.en: the peak of sexual pleasure and excitement

example.en: The doctor explained that the ability to reach orgasm varies from person to person.
example.zh: 医生解释说，达到性高潮的能力因人而异。

senses.en: a long flat surface in a shop or bank where customers are served

example.en: She paid at the counter.
example.zh: 她在柜台付了款。

senses.en: to reply to or oppose something

example.en: She countered his argument with clear evidence.
example.zh: 她用明确的证据反驳了他的论点。

senses.en: a device that counts things

example.en: The counter on the machine shows how many copies were made.
example.zh: 机器上的计数器显示已复印了多少份。

senses.en: special clothing worn by members of a group

example.en: The hotel staff wear a dark green uniform.
example.zh: 酒店员工穿着深绿色制服。

senses.en: the same in all parts or cases; not varying
senses.zh: 统一的；一致的；始终如一的

example.en: The tiles are of uniform size and color.
example.zh: 这些瓷砖大小和颜色一致。

senses.en: as it appears; according to what seems to be true

example.en: The seemingly simple problem took hours to solve.
example.zh: 这个看似简单的问题花了几个小时才解决。

senses.en: to become or make smaller, less, or weaker

example.en: The medicine will gradually diminish the pain.
example.zh: 这种药会逐渐减轻疼痛。

senses.en: to make someone or something seem less important or respected

example.en: Don't diminish her efforts by ignoring them.
example.zh: 不要忽视她的努力，从而贬低它们。

senses.en: available for everyone to use or see; not private

example.en: The town has a new public library.
example.zh: 这座城镇有一座新的公共图书馆。

senses.en: ordinary people in society, considered as a group

example.en: The government asked the public for its views on the plan.
example.zh: 政府就这项计划征求了公众的意见。

senses.en: known or seen by many people; not secret

example.en: The details of the agreement became public after the meeting.
example.zh: 会后，协议的细节公开了。

senses.en: to make someone remember something or think about it again

example.en: Please remind me to call my mother tomorrow.
example.zh: 请提醒我明天给妈妈打电话。

senses.en: to help someone remember words they have forgotten, especially in a play or speech
senses.zh: 提示（某人遗忘的台词或话语）

example.en: The prompter reminded the actor of his next line.
example.zh: 提词员提示了演员下一句台词。

collocations: remind someone of the next word

senses.en: an organization of workers formed to protect their interests and negotiate with employers

example.en: The union is negotiating a new contract for its members.
example.zh: 工会正在为其成员谈判一份新合同。

senses.en: the act of joining people or things together, or a group formed in this way

example.en: The countries agreed to form an economic union.
example.zh: 这些国家同意组建一个经济联盟。

senses.en: relating to a trade union

example.en: Union members are voting on the new contract.
example.zh: 工会成员正在对新合同进行投票。

senses.en: the process of judging the value, quality, or performance of something

example.en: The school will conduct an evaluation of the new reading program.
example.zh: 学校将对新的阅读课程进行评估。

senses.en: unconscious; unable to feel or respond

example.en: He was knocked senseless by the fall.
example.zh: 他摔得失去了知觉。

senses.en: pointless; without good reason

example.en: It would be senseless to argue about such a small thing.
example.zh: 为这么小的事争吵毫无意义。

senses.en: to put too much of a load or burden on someone or something

example.en: Don't overload the washing machine with too many clothes.
example.zh: 别往洗衣机里塞太多衣服。

senses.en: an excessive load or burden, especially too much work or electrical demand

example.en: The power failure was caused by an electrical overload.
example.zh: 停电是由电路过载引起的。

senses.en: to turn over and spread cut grass to dry in the sun

example.en: The farmer teds the hay so it dries evenly.
example.zh: 农民翻晒干草使其均匀干燥。

senses.en: without a paid job

example.en: He has been unemployed since the factory closed.
example.zh: 工厂倒闭后他一直失业。

senses.en: people without jobs, considered as a group

example.en: The new policy aims to provide training for the unemployed.
example.zh: 新政策旨在为失业者提供培训。

senses.en: large enough to be noticed or measured
senses.zh: 可观的；明显的；可察觉的

example.en: The new policy had an appreciable effect on air quality.
example.zh: 新政策对空气质量产生了明显的效果。

senses.en: a covering for the foot, typically with a sole and heel

example.en: I bought a new pair of shoes for running.
example.zh: 我买了一双新的跑步鞋。

senses.en: to fit a person or animal with shoes, or to put a shoe on a horse's hoof

example.en: The blacksmith shod the horse before the long journey.
example.zh: 长途跋涉之前，铁匠给马钉了蹄铁。

senses.en: a loud or unpleasant sound

example.en: The noise from the traffic kept me awake all night.
example.zh: 交通的噪音让我整夜没睡着。

senses.en: a sound of any kind

example.en: Did you hear that strange noise upstairs?
example.zh: 你听到楼上传来的怪声了吗？

senses.en: coming next after the fifth in position

example.en: She finished sixth in the race.
example.zh: 她在比赛中获得了第六名。

senses.en: one of six equal parts

example.en: They divided the pizza into sixths and he took one sixth.
example.zh: 他们把披萨分成六份，他拿了一份。

senses.en: position six in a series or ranking

example.en: The team is currently in sixth place.
example.zh: 该队目前排名第六。

senses.en: the Royal Air Force, the air force of the United Kingdom
senses.zh: 英国皇家空军（Royal Air Force 的缩写）

example.en: He served in the RAF for ten years.
example.zh: 他在英国皇家空军服役了十年。

senses.en: deliberate and unprovoked, showing no care about harm caused
senses.zh: 肆意的；无端恶意造成的

example.en: The fire was an act of wanton destruction.
example.zh: 这场火灾是一次蓄意的破坏行为。

senses.en: sexually unrestrained

example.en: The novel was criticized for its wanton characters.
example.zh: 这部小说因其中放荡的人物形象而受到批评。

senses.en: very worried, anxious and upset
senses.zh: 心烦意乱的，极度焦虑的

example.en: The distraught mother searched everywhere for her child.
example.zh: 心急如焚的母亲到处寻找她的孩子。

senses.en: a public road or main route connecting places

example.en: The shop stands on one of the busiest thoroughfares in the city.
example.zh: 这家商店位于全市最繁忙的大道之一。

senses.en: a party where guests wear masks and costumes

example.en: The palace held a grand masquerade.
example.zh: 宫殿举办了一场盛大的化装舞会。

senses.en: to pretend to be something one is not, often with 'as'

example.en: The spy masqueraded as a journalist.
example.zh: 间谍伪装成记者。

senses.en: a small green citrus fruit with a sour taste

example.en: She squeezed a lime into her drink.
example.zh: 她往饮料里挤了一个青柠。

senses.en: a white substance made from calcium oxide, used in building and farming

example.en: The builder mixed lime with sand to make mortar.
example.zh: 建筑工人把石灰和沙子混合制成砂浆。

senses.en: to add lime to soil or fields

example.en: Farmers lime the fields to reduce acidity.
example.zh: 农民给田地施石灰以降低酸性。

senses.en: a person who manages or controls an organization or department

example.en: The director approved the new budget for the department.
example.zh: 主管批准了该部门的新预算。

senses.en: a person who supervises the making of a film, play, or similar production

example.en: The director asked the actors to repeat the scene.
example.zh: 导演让演员们重演那一幕。

senses.en: a member of a board that governs a company or organization

example.en: She joined the board as an independent director.
example.zh: 她作为独立董事加入了董事会。

senses.en: a vehicle used to take sick or injured people to hospital

example.en: An ambulance arrived within minutes.
example.zh: 一辆救护车几分钟内就到了。

senses.en: a toothed tool used for arranging hair

example.en: She ran a comb through her wet hair.
example.zh: 她用梳子梳了梳湿头发。

senses.en: to arrange hair with a comb

example.en: He combed his hair before leaving.
example.zh: 他出门前梳了梳头发。

senses.en: to search a place thoroughly

example.en: Police combed the forest for the missing hiker.
example.zh: 警方在森林里仔细搜寻失踪的远足者。

senses.en: the red fleshy crest on a rooster's or hen's head

example.en: The rooster has a bright red comb.
example.zh: 这只公鸡有鲜红的鸡冠。

senses.en: not often; rarely

example.en: She seldom goes out on weekdays.
example.zh: 她工作日很少外出。

senses.en: old or broken things of little value; useless stuff

example.en: The garage was full of old junk nobody needed.
example.zh: 车库里堆满了没人需要的废旧杂物。

senses.en: to throw away or discard something useless

example.en: They decided to junk the old furniture and buy new pieces.
example.zh: 他们决定把旧家具扔掉，买新的。

senses.en: a traditional Chinese sailing boat with flat bottom and high stern

example.en: A wooden junk sailed slowly across the harbor.
example.zh: 一艘木帆船缓缓驶过海港。

senses.en: to collect and process used materials so they can be used again

example.en: We recycle paper, glass, and plastic at home.
example.zh: 我们在家里回收纸张、玻璃和塑料。

senses.en: lacking the skill or ability to do a job properly

example.en: He was dismissed for being incompetent at his job.
example.zh: 他因工作不称职而被解雇。

senses.en: a person who is not able to do a job or task well

example.en: The committee was accused of being staffed by incompetents.
example.zh: 该委员会被指责由无能之辈组成。

senses.en: to change the positions or arrangement of people or things, especially jobs in an organization

example.en: The company reshuffled its management team last month.
example.zh: 公司上个月改组了管理团队。

senses.en: an act of reorganizing, especially of government or company posts

example.en: The prime minister announced a cabinet reshuffle.
example.zh: 首相宣布了内阁改组。

senses.en: a person who gives up too easily
senses.zh: 轻易放弃的人；半途而废的人

example.en: He refused to quit the race because he was no quitter.
example.zh: 他拒绝放弃比赛，因为他不是轻易认输的人。

senses.en: a Japanese form of wrestling in which wrestlers try to force each other out of a ring or to the ground

example.en: He watches sumo tournaments on TV every year.
example.zh: 他每年都在电视上看相扑比赛。

senses.en: said or done with strong emphasis or force

example.en: She gave an emphatic no to the proposal.
example.zh: 她坚决地对这个提议说了不。

senses.en: clearly showing strength or success, as in a victory

example.en: The team won an emphatic victory in the final.
example.zh: 该队在决赛中取得了一场干脆利落的胜利。

senses.en: too strong to be defeated

example.en: The team seemed invincible this season.
example.zh: 这个队本赛季看起来不可战胜。

senses.en: a mammal of a group that includes armadillos, anteaters, and sloths, formerly classified as the order Edentata, typically with few or no teeth
senses.zh: 贫齿目动物（如犰狳、食蚁兽、树懒）

example.en: The armadillo is a well-known edentate.
example.zh: 犰狳是一种著名的贫齿目动物。

senses.en: having few or no teeth; relating to such mammals
senses.zh: 少齿的；无齿的；贫齿目的

example.en: Edentate mammals are found mainly in Central and South America.
example.zh: 贫齿目哺乳动物主要分布在中美洲和南美洲。

senses.en: an animal that mainly eats leaves

example.en: The howler monkey is a folivore that feeds on tree leaves.
example.zh: 吼猴是一种以树叶为食的食叶动物。

senses.en: justified or defensible; able to be shown as right, especially legally
senses.zh: 正当的；有正当理由的；可证明为合理的

example.en: The court decided that the search was warrantable under the law.
example.zh: 法院认定该搜查在法律上是正当的。
